Made with Natural Earth.

Natural Earth raster and vector map data are in the public domain.
The chart uses the Natural Earth 4.1.0 Admin 0 country boundaries at 1:50m,
redistributed as TopoJSON by world-atlas 2.0.2.

Terms of use: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Dataset documentation: https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas/blob/master/README.md

The separate world-atlas ISC license is preserved in world-atlas-LICENSE.txt.
This chart's procedural grain, facets and light are illustrative styling;
they are not geographic elevation or bathymetric measurements.
